watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「熱壓接合」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Thermocompression bonding. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「接合堆疊剖面」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Bond-stack cross-section requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「氧化與潤濕證據」列為查證任務：比較接合面、開路位置與良品對照，避免只用一张低倍率截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Oxide and wetting evidence: Compare bond faces, open-site maps and good controls rather than one low-magnification section. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：力—熱—位移耦合與接合後界面。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Force–temperature–displacement coupling and bonded interfaces. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作
related.why: 柱高與焊料帽是接合接觸分布的輸入
related.whyEn: Pillar height and solder caps set the contact distribution
related.transfer: 柱高與焊料帽是接合接觸分布的輸入
related.transferEn: Pillar height and solder caps set the contact distribution
related.difference: 凸塊製造的共面性不等於加熱受壓後共面性
related.differenceEn: Fabricated coplanarity differs from hot loaded coplanarity
practice: 以「接合堆疊剖面」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「上晶粒、接合點、下基板與工具各有剛性和熱膨脹，邊界不能簡化成兩個完全平板。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫受力與熱流兩張圖，標明受約束及自由伸長位置。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use bond-stack cross-section to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.

Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Die, joints, substrate and tools have distinct stiffness and expansion; the boundary is not simply two rigid planes.
Using "Draw separate load and heat-flow diagrams, identifying constrained and free-expansion locations.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.title: 直接銅對銅接合
related.why: 皆須控制表面、接觸面積與熱負荷
related.whyEn: Both control surfaces, contact area and thermal load
related.transfer: 皆須控制表面、接觸面積與熱負荷
related.transferEn: Both control surfaces, contact area and thermal load
related.difference: 熱壓可含焊料或聚合物，直接銅接合沒有焊料自對位假設
related.differenceEn: TCB may include solder or polymer; direct Cu bonding cannot assume solder self-alignment
practice: 以「位移回授與壓縮」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「量到的 Z 位移含工具、基板與接點變形，不能全部算成焊料壓縮。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「以空載與剛性參考比較回授，再同接合後間隙截面交叉驗證。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use displacement feedback and compression to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Measured Z motion includes tool, substrate and joint compliance; it is not all solder compression.
Using "Use unloaded and rigid references, then cross-check against post-bond gap sections.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
